tools.name: assess_grant_readiness
tools.description: Grant readiness check for nonprofits. Default (engine v3): about 36 Yes / In progress / No questions across six sections (Governance, Tax and registrations, Financials, Organizational background, Program or project, Policies). Returns a readiness bar per section with "[x] ready, [y] in progress, [z]

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assess_grant_readiness" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
